Vind je het boeiend om complexe data om te zetten in heldere inzichten die collega's helpen betere beslissingen te nemen?

Als BI Reporting Analyst speel je een belangrijke rol in het ondersteunen van onze organisatie met betrouwbare rapportering en data-inzichten. Je bouwt een grondige kennis op van onze systemen, data en businessprocessen en vertaalt deze naar rapporten, dashboards en analyses die dagelijks gebruikt worden door sales, boekhouding, management en directie.

Je bent niet alleen technisch sterk, maar begrijpt ook de business achter de cijfers. Dankzij jouw interesse in commerciële processen slaag je erin om data om te zetten in informatie die écht bruikbaar is voor de organisatie.
Jouw uitdaging
Je bouwt een grondige kennis op van onze systemen, databronnen en backofficeprocessen.
Je ontwikkelt, onderhoudt en optimaliseert rapporten, dashboards en KPI-overzichten voor verschillende afdelingen.
Je vertaalt businessvragen van sales, finance, management en directie naar duidelijke rapporteringsoplossingen.
Je bewaakt de kwaliteit, consistentie en betrouwbaarheid van de data waarop rapporteringen gebaseerd zijn.
Je zorgt voor een efficiënte distributie en documentatie van rapporteringen.
Je voert analyses uit die operationele beslissingen ondersteunen.
Je detecteert afwijkingen en opportuniteiten in de data en vertaalt deze naar concrete inzichten.
Je ondersteunt collega's bij de interpretatie van rapporten en cijfers.
Je denkt actief mee over nieuwe KPI's, rapporteringsbehoeften en optimalisaties van bestaande processen.
Je fungeert als brug tussen businessgebruikers en technische teams.
Jouw profiel
Je beschikt over 1.5 tot 4 jaar relevante ervaring in een gelijkaardige rol.
Je bent gepassioneerd door cijfers, data en analyse.
Je werkt nauwkeurig, gestructureerd en hebt oog voor detail.
Je bent nieuwsgierig en wil begrijpen hoe bedrijfsprocessen werken, van commerciële activiteiten tot financiële verwerking.
Je hebt een sterke interesse in commerciële processen en de impact ervan op bedrijfsresultaten.
Je kan cijfers niet alleen rapporteren, maar ook interpreteren en toelichten aan business stakeholders.
Je hebt ervaring met BI- en rapporteringstools zoals Qlik Sense, Power BI, Tableau of gelijkaardige oplossingen.
Je hebt een goede kennis van SQL en databanken.
Een gevorderde kennis van Excel is een pluspunt.
Kennis van Python of andere analysetools is een troef.
Je communiceert vlot met zowel operationele gebruikers als management.
Je hebt een uitstekende kennis van het Nederlands. Een goede kennis van Frans is een plus.
We bieden je

Bij Mediafin kom je terecht in een succesvol mediabedrijf. Innovatie, ambitie en ondernemingszin maken deel uit van ons DNA. Talent vormt de kern van wie we zijn. Daarom hechten we veel belang aan je persoonlijke ontwikkeling, een fijne werksfeer en een aangename werkomgeving op de bruisende site van Tour & Taxis.
Over Trustmedia

Trustmedia is de Advertising Solutions afdeling van Mediafin, uitgever van de zakenkranten en nieuwssites De Tijd en L’Echo, de personal finance magazines Mijn Geld/Mon Argent het weekendmagazine Sabato en de nieuwsbrieven De Belegger/L’Investisseur.
Met steeds vernieuwende communicatieoplossingen speelt Trustmedia in op de behoeften van haar klanten en streeft daarbij steeds naar het versterken van hun groei en hun marktpositie.

Research, advertising, crossmediale content services, projecten op maat en datatoepassingen, behoren tot de expertises van onze medewerkers. Hun oplossingen vertalen zich in steeds meer klanten. Op die manier verzekert Trustmedia aan bedrijven en organisaties een directe en efficiënte toegang tot het unieke en steeds groeiende lezerspubliek van De Tijd en L’Echo.

Op die manier verzekert Trustmedia aan bedrijven en organisaties een directe en efficiënte toegang tot het unieke en steeds groeiende lezerspubliek van De Tijd en L’Echo.

As Lansweeper scales its SaaS business across new products and markets, revenue analytics has become a critical function for steering executive and board-level decisions. This role exists to bring structure, trust, and clarity to how Lansweeper measures and understands its revenue.

You will be the dedicated Revenue Analytics Engineer within a 10-person Data & Analytics team — the first hire focused entirely on revenue — reporting directly to the Data Platform Manager. Your work will directly shape how C-level leaders and the board understand growth, and how sales and finance teams plan and act.
In the near term, your goals are to establish a single source of truth for revenue KPIs, build board-ready reporting, and deliver forecasting models that drive go-to-market decisions.
Challenge
The Main Challenges You'll Face Are

Speed vs. complexity: The sales organization moves fast and needs reliable revenue facts quickly — but revenue data is sourced from multiple systems (CRM, billing, ERP) with historic complexity from acquisitions and system migrations, and data quality that varies over time.

Keeping up with a changing business:** As Lansweeper's product and market evolve, sales and marketing allocation must follow. You'll need to continuously adapt revenue models to reflect new business processes and priorities.

Being the first and only:** You are the sole analytics engineer focused on revenue. You'll need to build foundations from scratch, establish trust in the numbers, and earn your seat at the table with finance and executive stakeholders — all at the same time.
Key Responsibilities
Build, maintain, and improve revenue data models** that power executive-level reporting and board-ready metrics across ARR, MRR, churn, expansion, contraction, and renewal cycles
Reconcile revenue data across systems of record** — CRM, billing, and ERP — and establish a single, trusted source of truth for financial KPIs
Design and deliver dashboards and reports** that translate complex revenue data into clear, actionable insights for sales, finance, and leadership
Partner with sales operations and finance** to understand evolving business processes and reflect them accurately in revenue analytics models
Develop and maintain forecasting models** for key revenue metrics to support go-to-market planning and strategic decision-making
Investigate and explain trends, anomalies, and shifts** in revenue data, linking them back to underlying sales and finance drivers
Proactively improve data quality and integrity** across revenue-related data pipelines to ensure consistent, reliable reporting
Key Requirements
Hard Skills
Financial metrics reporting — solid understanding of how revenue, bookings, churn, ARR, MRR, expansion, contraction, and renewal KPIs are defined and measured in a SaaS context
Strong SQL skills — ability to write, optimize, and debug complex queries against large datasets
Systems reconciliation — hands-on experience resolving data mismatches between CRM, billing, and finance systems to produce a reliable single source of truth
Data modelling — familiarity with best practices such as dimensional modelling and slowly changing dimensions

Als brug tussen business en technologie ben je verantwoordelijk voor het vertalen van businessvragen naar concrete oplossingen op het dataplatform, en waak je erover dat deze oplossingen effectief gebruikt worden en waarde leveren.

Je hebt ervaring in een rol op het snijvlak van business en data (functioneel analist, data analyst, product analyst, …).

Je begrijpt hoe dataplatformen werken (data pipelines, modellering, rapportering).

Ervaring met Microsoft Fabric, Azure of gelijkaardige platformen (bv. Databricks, Synapse, Snowflake, Cloudera) is een pluspunt.

Een top team: waarin nieuwe frisse ideeën en initiatieven steeds welkom zijn! Team-events, happy hours en een steeds legendarisch bedrijfsfeest horen daar ook bij

We hechten waarde aan duurzaamheid door CO2-neutraliteit na te streven met de elektrificatie van ons wagenpark en een milieuvriendelijk datacenter. We ontwikkelen innovatieve oplossingen met een positieve impact op milieu, mens en maatschappij, en streven naar een inclusieve en diverse werkomgeving waarin iedereen gewaardeerd en gehoord wordt.

Hybride werkmodel dat efficiënt kantoor- en thuiswerk combineert.
Persoonlijke begeleiding door managers, coaches en sparringpartners.
ESG: lagere emissies, bevorderen van inclusie en duurzaamheid in IT.

You’ll gather business requirements and document these in user stories and business use cases

Participate in advisory of clients on the set-up of data departments and teams (incl. defining roles and responsibilities).
Your qualifications
You have a first of experience with functional- and/or business analysis
You are fluent in speaking both Dutch and English
You have experience gathering business requirements
You like to interact with and guide businesspeople towards a solution generating business impact
You have a thorough understanding of SQL, and a hunger to discover and develop new technical skills
You have hands on experience with data visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau,…
You have an analytical mindset, good communication and interpersonal skills
Proven success in contributing to a team-oriented environment
Our offer
A highly entrepreneurial team
A no-nonsense working environment with a focus on high quality
Excellent terms of employment (including company car, fuel card, meal vouchers & bonus)
Fringe benefits including continuous training that builds and extends professional, technical and management skills in all areas
The opportunity to grow together with Datashift in terms of capabilities as well as financial benefits.

As a Data Analyst, you will help organizations turn complex data into meaningful insights and practical business solutions. You will work at the intersection of data, technology and business, supporting clients in improving data foundations, processes and decision-making.

In this role, you will contribute to data-driven transformation initiatives, working closely with business stakeholders, data teams and technology teams. You will combine hands-on data preparation and analysis with project management and a strong understanding of business needs.
What you will do
Data Analysis & Preparation
Collect, combine and prepare data from multiple sources for analysis and reporting.
Design, maintain and optimize data flows and transformation processes.
Analyze datasets to identify trends, patterns, anomalies and opportunities.
Translate business questions into data-driven analyses and practical recommendations.
Investigate data quality issues and work with data owners and providers to resolve them.
Develop dashboards, visualizations and analytical outputs to support business decision-making.
Data & Process Transformation
Analyze existing data processes and identify opportunities for improvement and automation.
Contribute to the redesign and optimization of data flows and analytical processes.
Support data migration and transformation initiatives, including the transition to new data environments and tools.
Challenge existing ways of working and propose innovative and scalable solutions.
Help establish robust and sustainable data foundations.
Project & Stakeholder Management
Manage and coordinate data-related activities and project deliverables.
Work closely with business users, data providers, IT teams and other stakeholders across different functions and locations.
Translate business and operational requirements into clear data solutions.
Plan, monitor and communicate progress, risks and dependencies.
Present findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Your profile
3–5 years of experience in data analytics, business analysis or data-related transformation projects.
Experience in project management or project delivery is required.
Hands-on experience with Dataiku is required.
Knowledge of Alteryx is required.
Experience with data visualization tools such as Tableau is a strong plus.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a structured and detail-oriented approach.
Comfortable working with multiple data sources, data preparation and ETL/data transformation processes.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
Curious, proactive and eager to understand new business domains and processes.
A Master's degree in a quantitative, technical or analytical field is preferred, but equivalent practical experience is also valued.
Fluent in English and French
column2: Dutch is a strong plus.

We do this by striving to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome to be who they are—with the freedom to exchange ideas, think innovatively, and listen to each other and customers in meaningful ways. Moody’s is transforming how the world sees risk. As a global leader in ratings and integrated risk assessment, we’re advancing AI to move from insight to action—enabling intelligence that not only understands complexity but responds to it. We decode risk to unlock opportunity, helping our clients navigate uncertainty with clarity, speed, and confidence.

If you are excited about this opportunity but do not meet every single requirement, please apply! You still may be a great fit for this role or other open roles. We are seeking candidates who model our values: invest in every relationship, lead with curiosity, champion diverse perspectives, turn inputs into actions, and uphold trust through integrity.
Skills And Competencies
Strong ability to interpret, analyse, and validate complex ownership and entity relationship data
High attention to detail with a strong commitment to data accuracy, integrity, and quality control
Effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to respond clearly to client enquiries
Strong organisational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
Problem-solving mindset with a proactive approach to process improvement and operational efficiency
Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with internal and external stakeholders
Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications
Knowledge of SQL, Databricks, Python, or Power BI is considered an asset
Strong proficiency in English, both written and spoken, is required. Professional fluency in Polish, Turkish, or Arabic is a plus
Interest in emerging technologies and willingness to learn how AI-enabled tools can enhance data quality, research capabilities, and operational efficiency
Education
Bachelor's degree (Bachelor Universitaire/Hogeschool) or Master's degree in Economics, Finance, Statistics, Data Analytics, Computer Science, or a related discipline
Equivalent experience and qualifications will also be considered
Entry-level candidates are welcome to apply
Responsibilities
This role is responsible for managing, enriching, and validating relationship data to ensure the accuracy, consistency, and reliability of information delivered to internal and external clients.
Maintain and enhance relationship data within Moody's relationship data platform using automated feeds, validation workflows, AI-assisted tools, and expert data analysis
Operate control mechanisms and matching processes to ensure data quality and integrity
Respond to client requests and enquiries, providing timely, clear, and effective data support
Support internal and external clients in accessing, understanding, and using relationship and entity data
Deliver weekly updates on relationships, legal entities, and complex corporate relationship structures
Continuously review and improve processes and procedures to increase efficiency, speed, and accuracy of data updates
Contribute to the expansion of existing data offerings by researching new data sources and supporting the integration of additional data elements
Produce and maintain high-quality documentation, including internal procedures, data definitions, methodologies, and FAQs
Identify opportunities to leverage emerging technologies, including AI-enabled solutions, to improve data management processes and operational effectiveness
Collaborate with colleagues and stakeholders to support broader data and client service objectives
About The Team

The team is responsible for delivering high-quality ownership and entity relationship data to a global client base. Working at the intersection of data, research, client support, and technology, the team plays a critical role in ensuring transparency, accuracy, and trust in complex relationship structures. Through a combination of expert analysis, data-driven processes, and AI-enabled tools, the team continuously improves data coverage, quality, and operational efficiency. Team members are encouraged to explore innovative technologies and contribute to the ongoing evolution of data management, client service, and analytical capabilities in a rapidly changing environment.

Moody’s is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender expression, gender identity or any other characteristic protected by law.

Candidates for Moody's Corporation may be asked to disclose securities holdings pursuant to Moody’s Policy for Securities Trading and the requirements of the position. Employment is contingent upon compliance with the Policy, including remediation of positions in those holdings as necessary.

Why are we here?

Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic, and labelling is accurate.

Eurofins is dedicated to delivering testing services that contribute to the health and safety of society and the planet, and to its corporate responsibility to protect the environment and ensure diversity, equity, and inclusion across the entire network of Eurofins companies.
Job Description
In a nutshell

The IT Reporting & Documentation Analyst will drive the creation of reports, memos and other documents from the Eurofins IT Organisation for senior executives in the Eurofins Group at the request of the Group CIO and senior IT leadership. The role requires the ability to synthesise information and business intelligence from a variety of sources including those concerning technical compliance, budget, Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), and other metrics, and to communicate the information clearly, including explanation of underlying data and calculations
Where will you be based and what business will you support?
This hybrid position is based in Brussels, Brussels Region, Belgium, with a minimum of two days per week in the office.
How can you help us?

You will help us transform complex IT, operational, financial and business data into clear, insightful and executive-level communications. By working closely with senior IT leadership and stakeholders across the organisation, you will ensure that reporting, documentation and strategic messaging are accurate, consistent and impactful. Your analytical skills and attention to detail will support data-driven decision-making while driving continuous improvement in the quality of IT communications and governance documentation.
What can we do for you?

We offer the opportunity to work on impactful, global IT projects within a collaborative and international environment, providing exposure to business-critical systems, continuous learning, and professional growth opportunities.
Qualifications
Are you our kind of extraordinary?

You are an analytical storyteller who enjoys turning complex data into meaningful insights and compelling narratives. You thrive in collaborative environments, build strong relationships with diverse stakeholders and are comfortable working with senior leaders. You combine exceptional written communication skills with critical thinking, business acumen and a passion for quality. If you enjoy bringing structure, clarity and consistency to complex information, we'd love to hear from you.
You have:
Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Statistics, Information Systems, Mathematics, Communications, or a related field.
3–7 years of experience producing executive-level reports, governance documentation, performance reporting or business communications.
Proven ability to analyse and interpret complex financial, operational, technical and statistical data and translate findings into executive-level recommendations.
Exceptional written and verbal English communication skills.
Experience with Power BI, Excel reporting and dashboard interpretation.
Strong understanding of KPI methodologies and performance measurement.
Excellent stakeholder management, collaboration and communication skills.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to high-quality deliverables.
Nice to have:
Knowledge of IT and documentation frameworks such as SDLC, ITIL, ISO/IEC 27001 and ISO 9001.
Experience in IT governance, executive reporting, business analytics or strategic communications.
Exposure to large, complex or multinational organisations.
Additional Information
We support your development! Do you feel like you don’t match 100% of the requirements? Don’t hesitate to apply anyway! Eurofins companies are committed to supporting your career development.

We embrace diversity! As an Equal Opportunity Employer, the Eurofins network of companies believes in strength and innovation through diversity. We prohibit discrimination against employees or applications based on gender identity and/or expression, race, nationality, age, religion, sexual orientation, disability, and everything else that makes employees of Eurofins companies unique.
Find out more on our Careers page: https://careers.eurofins.com/

Company description: Eurofins Scientific is an international network of independent life sciences companies, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate.

The Eurofins network of companies believes that it is a global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and agroscience contract research services. It is also one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in biopharma contract development and manufacturing. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products.

In under 40 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to over 65,000 employees across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of over 950 laboratories in over 1,000 independent companies across 59 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products.
The Eurofins network generated EUR 7.296 billion revenues in FY 2025, and has been one of the fastest growing listed European companies for almost three decades.

Company description: Eurofins Scientific is an international network of independent life sciences companies, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate.

The Eurofins network of companies believes that it is a global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and agroscience contract research services. It is also one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in biopharma contract development and manufacturing. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products.


In under 40 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to over 65,000 employees across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of over 950 laboratories in over 1,000 independent companies across 59 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products.


The Eurofins network generated EUR 7.296 billion revenues in FY 2025, and has been one of the fastest growing listed European companies for almost three decades.

Deine Analysen bilden die Grundlage für nachvollziehbare Testberichte, fundierte technische Entscheidungen und die Verbesserung unserer Systemmodelle. Gleichzeitig unterstützt du den Aufbau eines digitalen Zwillings, der zukünftig eine zentrale Rolle in Simulation, Entwicklung und Validierung einnehmen wird.

Du analysierst komplexe Datenbestände im GEVER-Umfeld, erkennst Auffälligkeiten und erstellst fundierte technische Entscheidungsgrundlagen.
Die Datenqualität prüfst du systematisch und setzt geeignete Bereinigungs-, Harmonisie­rungs- und Validierungsmassnahmen um.
Du entwickelst, optimierst und dokumentierst SQL-Abfragen, Skripte sowie automati­sierte Analyse- und Prüfroutinen.
Für relationale Datenbanken übernimmst du den Betrieb, die Überwachung und die Weiterentwicklung und stellst Performance, Verfügbarkeit und Stabilität sicher.
Du planst und testest Backup-, Restore-, Recovery- und Wiederanlaufverfahren und setzt diese im Ereignisfall zuverlässig ein.
Bei Datenmigrationen, Störungsanalysen und Weiterentwicklungsvorhaben wirkst du aktiv mit und arbeitest eng mit Fachbereichen, Betrieb, Entwicklung und externen Partnern zusammen.
Das macht Sie einzigartig
Du verfügst über einen Abschluss in Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Data Engineering, Data Science oder über eine vergleichbare Aus- und Weiterbildung.
Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Datenbankumfeld sowie sehr gute Kenntnisse in relationalen Datenbanken, SQL, Datenmodellen und Performanceanalyse bringst du mit.
Du hast Praxiserfahrung in der Analyse komplexer Datenbestände, in Datenqualität, Datenbereinigung, Migrationen sowie ETL- oder ELT-Prozessen.
Mindestens eine Skript- oder Programmiersprache, beispielsweise PowerShell oder Python, beherrschst du sicher.
Du besitzt ein gutes Verständnis für Backup, Restore, Recovery, Monitoring, Betriebs­systeme, Schnittstellen und Applikationsarchitekturen.
Mit analytischem Denkvermögen, hoher Eigenverantwortung und einer sorgfältigen Arbeitsweise überzeugst du ebenso wie mit guten Kenntnissen einer Amtssprache und Englischkenntnissen.
Auf den Punkt gebracht

Du suchst keine klassische Datenbank-Administratorenstelle und auch keine reine Data-Scientist-Funktion. Du möchtest Daten verstehen, technische Ursachen ermitteln und gleich­zeitig Verantwortung für stabile Datenbankplattformen übernehmen. Bei uns arbeitest du an der Schnittstelle von Datenanalyse, Datenbank-Engineering und Be­trieb. Deine Arbeit hat unmittelbare Wirkung: Du unterstützt den zuverlässigen Betrieb der elektronischen Geschäftsverwaltung, verbesserst die Qualität zentraler Geschäftsdaten und schaffst die Grundlage für fundierte technische und fachliche Entscheide auf Basis unserer Kundendaten. Du erhältst Gestaltungsspielraum, übernimmst Verantwortung für anspruchsvolle Themen und arbeitest in einem Umfeld, in dem Datenintegrität, Informationssicherheit und nachhal­tige Lösungen einen hohen Stellenwert haben. Gesund am Arbeitsplatz Wir unterstützen und beraten unsere Mitarbeitenden im Bereich der physischen und psychischen Gesundheit.
Alle Benefits

Wir entwickeln, be-treiben und unterstützen moderne E-Government-Anwendungen und leisten einen wichtigen Beitrag zur digitalen Transformation der Bundesverwaltung. Data Analyst
Location: Zurich (Hybrid)
Type: Full-time
Department: BFSI2
Job Summary

eClerx is seeking a Data Analyst to support one of our leading global financial services clients. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring the accuracy, integrity and governance of critical reference data, including Legal Entity (LEM) IDs and Industry Codes, while supporting data quality remediation initiatives across multiple business functions.

Working closely with global Operations, Technology, Change, and Data teams, you will identify, investigate and resolve data quality issues, maintain documentation, monitor production processes and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance operational efficiency and data accuracy.
Responsibilities
Ensure the accurate population and ongoing maintenance of Legal Entity (LEM) IDs and Industry Codes for in-scope clients.
Develop a strong understanding of the underlying data model and support data quality remediation programmes to resolve identified issues.
Partner with global teams to deliver excellent client service and seamless operational support.
Continuously monitor production processes to identify exceptions, anomalies and potential data quality issues in real time.
Investigate, analyse and resolve data discrepancies across multiple databases, applications and operational systems.
Maintain comprehensive documentation of front-to-back architecture, data remediation methodologies, processes and outcomes.
Collaborate with Technology, Data Owners, Change teams and other stakeholders to develop and implement effective data remediation strategies.

Dans le cadre d’un projet de transformation Data, notre client souhaite renforcer son équipe avec un Data Analytics Engineer expert Power BI et Microsoft Fabric.

La mission s’inscrit dans un projet de remplacement de Tableau par Power BI, avec des enjeux autour de l’ingestion et de la modélisation des données, du développement de dashboards et de l’accompagnement des équipes Data.

Concevoir et développer des pipelines d’ingestion de données dans Microsoft Fabric, notamment à partir de bases SQL.
Collecter, préparer, nettoyer et structurer les données provenant de différentes sources.
Garantir la qualité, la cohérence et la gouvernance des données.
Concevoir et maintenir des modèles de données et modèles sémantiques robustes et performants.
Développer des rapports et dashboards interactifs sous Power BI.
Développer des mesures et calculs avancés en DAX.
Optimiser les performances des rapports et datasets Power BI.
Comprendre et challenger les besoins d’analyse métier et rédiger les spécifications associées.
Accompagner et former les Data Analysts sur Power BI afin de les rendre autonomes dans la réalisation de dashboards complexes.

Excellente maîtrise de Power BI et Microsoft Fabric.
Expérience professionnelle solide de Microsoft Fabric, notamment sur des sujets de développement et de Data Engineering.
Maîtrise de la modélisation de données : Star Schema, Snowflake, Datamarts Power BI.
Très bonne maîtrise de DAX.
Bonnes connaissances de SQL et des problématiques d’ingestion de données.
Expérience confirmée dans la réalisation rapide de dashboards Power BI complexes et performants.
Capacité à rédiger des spécifications et à comprendre et challenger les besoins métier.
Connaissance de Tableau appréciée.
Excellentes capacités de communication et de pédagogie, notamment pour accompagner les autres Data Analysts.

Contexte de la mission :

Dans le cadre d’un projet de transformation Data, notre client souhaite renforcer son équipe avec un Data Analytics Engineer expert Power BI et Microsoft Fabric.

La mission s’inscrit dans un projet de remplacement de Tableau par Power BI, avec des enjeux autour de l’ingestion et de la modélisation des données, du développement de dashboards et de l’accompagnement des équipes Data.


Vos activités principales

Vous serez notamment en charge de :


  • Concevoir et développer des pipelines d’ingestion de données dans Microsoft Fabric, notamment à partir de bases SQL.
  • Collecter, préparer, nettoyer et structurer les données provenant de différentes sources.
  • Garantir la qualité, la cohérence et la gouvernance des données.
  • Concevoir et maintenir des modèles de données et modèles sémantiques robustes et performants.
  • Développer des rapports et dashboards interactifs sous Power BI.
  • Développer des mesures et calculs avancés en DAX.
  • Optimiser les performances des rapports et datasets Power BI.
  • Comprendre et challenger les besoins d’analyse métier et rédiger les spécifications associées.
  • Accompagner et former les Data Analysts sur Power BI afin de les rendre autonomes dans la réalisation de dashboards complexes.


Compétences recherchées :

  • Excellente maîtrise de Power BI et Microsoft Fabric.
  • Expérience professionnelle solide de Microsoft Fabric, notamment sur des sujets de développement et de Data Engineering.
  • Maîtrise de la modélisation de données : Star Schema, Snowflake, Datamarts Power BI.
  • Très bonne maîtrise de DAX.
  • Bonnes connaissances de SQL et des problématiques d’ingestion de données.
  • Expérience confirmée dans la réalisation rapide de dashboards Power BI complexes et performants.
  • Capacité à rédiger des spécifications et à comprendre et challenger les besoins métier.
  • Connaissance de Tableau appréciée.
  • Excellentes capacités de communication et de pédagogie, notamment pour accompagner les autres Data Analysts.

Deine Aufgaben
Du verantwortest mindestens einen Themenbereich fachlich und stellst die Vertretung für mehrere weitere sicher.
Du beantwortest Anfragen und deckst Informationsbedürfnisse von Verwaltung, Bevölkerung, Parlament, Medien und weiteren Interessengruppen.
Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit den beteiligten Fachpersonen fundierte Analysen und Datenprodukte und begleitest deren technische Umsetzung bis zur produktiven Nutzung.

Du entwickelst reproduzierbare Datenpipelines sowie statistische Modelle und Verfahren und überführst geeignete Ansätze gemeinsam mit dem Team in verlässlich nutzbare Lösungen, um Datenanalysen transparent und nachvollziehbar zu gestalten.

Du entwickelst strukturierten und getesteten Code, vorwiegend in R, und arbeitest an wiederverwendbaren Paketen und Komponenten mit. Git, Code Reviews und automatisierte Tests gehören dabei zu deiner täglichen Entwicklungsarbeit.

Du erschliesst und beurteilst Datenquellen, achtest auf Datenqualität und Nachvollziehbarkeit und vermittelst Methoden, Annahmen und Ergebnisse auch gegenüber nichttechnischen Anspruchsgruppen verständlich.

Du verfügst über einen Masterabschluss in Data Science, Informatik, Statistik, Mathematik, Volkswirtschaftslehre, Computational Science oder einem vergleichbaren quantitativen Fachgebiet.

Du hast praktische Erfahrung in Data Science, Data Engineering oder Scientific Software Engineering und bereits Datenanalysen, Datenpipelines, Modelle oder vergleichbare Datenlösungen selbständig umgesetzt.
Du verfügst über fundierte Kenntnisse in Statistik, Datenmodellierung und Datenqualität.
Du beherrschst R und/oder Python sehr gut und kannst damit strukturierten, getesteten und wartbaren Code entwickeln.
Du kennst grundlegende Praktiken professioneller Softwareentwicklung. Git-basierte Zusammenarbeit, Code Reviews und automatisierte Tests sind dir vertraut.
Du hast Erfahrung in der Koordination von Projekten oder in der Zusammenarbeit mit unterschiedlichen Fachdisziplinen und Anspruchsgruppen.

Du arbeitest selbständig, sorgfältig und lösungsorientiert. Komplexe fachliche und technische Sachverhalte kannst du strukturieren, unterschiedliche Perspektiven aufnehmen und deine Ergebnisse und Entscheidungen verständlich vermitteln.
Du kommunizierst stilsicher auf Deutsch. Deine Englischkenntnisse ermöglichen dir den sicheren Umgang mit technischer Dokumentation und internationaler Fachliteratur.
Von Vorteil
Kenntnisse in SQL und relationaler Datenmodellierung.
Kenntnisse in SAS oder Erfahrung im Umgang mit bestehenden SAS-Prozessen.
Erste Erfahrung mit produktiv betriebenen Datenpipelines, Paketentwicklung, CI/CD oder vergleichbaren Data-Science-Engineering-Praktiken.
Erfahrung mit Daten und Prozessen der öffentlichen Statistik oder vergleichbaren regulierten Datenumgebungen.
Dein Arbeitgeber

LUSTAT Statistik Luzern ist das Kompetenz- und Dienstleistungszentrum der öffentlichen Statistik im Kanton Luzern. Die Statistikstelle erhebt und analysiert Daten aus dem Kanton Luzern und seinen Gemeinden und stellt diese Informationen der Öffentlichkeit benutzergerecht zur Verfügung. Zudem bietet sie individuelle, kostenpflichtige Leistungen an. Dazu gehören fachliche und methodische Beratungen, Sonderauswertungen, Gesamtdarstellungen, Szenarien und Modellrechnungen.
Worauf du dich freuen kannst

Du arbeitest an vielfältigen statistischen Fragestellungen mit direktem Nutzen für Bevölkerung, Verwaltung, Politik, Wirtschaft, Wissenschaft und Medien und bist eng mit Fachpersonen aus unterschiedlichen Disziplinen im Austausch. Du arbeitest in einem interdisziplinären Umfeld mit hoher Daten- und Methodenkompetenz.

Wir entwickeln unsere Datenverarbeitung kontinuierlich weiter und setzen dabei verstärkt auf R, reproduzierbare Workflows und moderne Entwicklungspraktiken. Du kannst diese Entwicklung aktiv mitgestalten.
Wir bauen unsere Entwicklungspraktiken gezielt weiter aus und setzen dabei zunehmend auf Git, Code Reviews, automatisierte Tests, reproduzierbare Prozesse und CI/CD.

Open-Source-Lösungen und On-Premises-Betrieb spielen in unserem technischen Umfeld eine wichtige Rolle. Dabei lernst du auch, wie technische Möglichkeiten mit den Anforderungen an Datenschutz und Informationssicherheit in Einklang gebracht werden.

Wir unterstützen dich dabei, deine Kenntnisse in Statistik, Softwareentwicklung und Data Science weiterzuentwickeln. Dazu gehören interne und externe Weiterbildungen ebenso wie der fachliche Austausch und die praktische Arbeit an produktiven Datenlösungen.

Flexible Jahresarbeitszeit, bis zu drei Tage Homeoffice pro Woche, ein moderner Arbeitsplatz im neuen Gebäude der kantonalen Verwaltung des Kantons Luzern direkt neben dem Bahnhof Emmenbrücke ergänzen unser Angebot.

4457484933,https://ch.linkedin.com/jobs/view/junior-power-analyst-at-dxt-commodities-4457484933?position=26&pageNum=0&refId=l39hWZCuCyXnWenotZoztQ%3D%3D&trackingId=IZr%2BMzPV6VrIath7R8MLag%3D%3D,Junior Power Analyst,DXT Commodities,"Lugano, Ticino, Switzerland","Junior Power Analyst

As a result of our continuing expansion, an exciting position has opened up in our Power Trading Team for a Junior Power Analyst. This role offers the opportunity to work, learn and grow alongside experienced traders and analysts, directly contributing to the Team’s success in European power markets.

The successful candidate will work on the development and daily operation of fundamental stack model for European power markets, simulating supply and demand scenarios, analysing market fundamentals and contributing to the development of trading strategies. The role will involve working with large datasets and translating changes in generation, demand, weather, cross-border flows and other market fundamentals into meaningful market insights.
Strong business acumen is required, as well as a passion for quantitative analysis and development, given the continuous interaction with Traders, Meteorologists, Analysts and IT Developers.
Requirements

Ideally, you will have 1–2 years of experience in an analytical environment and a degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, or Quantitative Economics/Finance, with a solid academic background.
Strong data analysis and coding skills (Python and SQL) are essential. You will be fluent in English, while a second European language will be considered a plus.
Although not strictly required, previous experience or knowledge of power markets, energy markets, optimisation or fundamental market modelling would be advantageous.
Offer
DXT offers a full-time permanent position with a competitive remuneration package. Relocation support, where appropriate, is also provided.

On-the-job training will be provided by seasoned professionals directly on the trading desk. The successful candidate will also receive DXT’s benefits and well-being package and will be supported by the Duferco Academy for professional growth and development.
Please send your updated CV together with a cover letter to: hr.power.analyst@dxt.com

4455314173,https://ch.linkedin.com/jobs/view/natural-gas-analyst-at-metlen-4455314173?position=28&pageNum=0&refId=l39hWZCuCyXnWenotZoztQ%3D%3D&trackingId=%2B%2F7k%2BELnv3DfY6ThgQSFPw%3D%3D,Natural Gas Analyst,Metlen,"Zug, Zug, Switzerland","Job description:

At METLEN Energy & Metals, we are catalysts for a sustainable future, positioned at the forefront of the energy transition while being a reference point for competitive green metallurgy at both the European and global levels.  We are a global industrial and energy company operating across two highly interconnected and complementary sectors: Energy and Metals. With a consolidated turnover of €5,683 million and an EBITDA of €1,080 million, along with a workforce of over 7,627 dedicated individuals, we drive success through cutting-edge technology and diverse talent.

We are committed to embracing new state-of-the-art technologies and advancements, propelling us towards a cleaner, brighter tomorrow. Our positive footprint extends across five continents, creating a lasting impact. At METLEN, we foster a culture of resilience, challenge, respect, excellence, and change, empowering our diverse workforce to achieve remarkable outcomes.
We are currently looking for a Natural Gas Analyst to join our International Energy Trading division in Zug, Switzerland.

In this role, you will be an integral part of the trading desk: building, maintaining, and refining fundamental and quantitative market models to identify commercial opportunities across European gas markets.
Working directly with traders, you will translate complex data into actionable insights that directly form trading strategies and risk management decisions.
Your role will encompass:
Developing, maintaining, and continuously improving short- and long-term supply and demand models, storage forecasts, and regional flow models across key European gas hubs.
Monitoring daily physical gas infrastructure dynamics, including cross-border capacity constraints, pipeline nominations, storage injection/withdrawal rates, and LNG import schedules.
Providing traders with market intelligence, trade ideas, and scenario analyses to support proprietary trading decisions.
Building and automating data pipelines and analytical tools, transforming complex energy data into actionable insights and user-friendly dashboards.
Monitoring macroeconomic, regulatory, and policy developments, including EU ETS and other factors affecting European energy balances.
Working closely with traders, quantitative analysts, and other teams to translate market data and analysis into actionable trading strategies.
Continuously improving analytical models, data quality, and processes to support a fast-paced trading environment.
What you bring to the role:
3+ years of experience as a gas market analyst within an energy trading company, utility, consultancy, or commodity brokerage.
Strong understanding of the fundamental drivers of major European gas hubs, including TTF, THE, PSV, CEGH, and NBP.
In-depth knowledge of European gas infrastructure, including pipeline networks, storage facilities, interconnections, and LNG regasification infrastructure.
Understanding the gas-to-power relationship, renewable intermittency, and the impact of carbon prices on European energy markets.
Advanced proficiency in Python, SQL, and Excel, with hands-on experience in data extraction, statistical modelling, and process automation.
Experience with data visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau and relevant energy market data sources.
Strong analytical and quantitative capabilities, with excellent attention to detail and the ability to interpret complex, fast-moving datasets.
Ability to work independently, communicate insights clearly, and deliver under tight deadlines in a fast-paced trading environment.
Share the same Value Based Behaviors:
People & Personal Growth
Results Orientation & Safety Excellence
Collaboration & Trust
Empathy & Effective Communication
Flexibility & Adaptability
Your Benefits:
Competitive remuneration package including performance-based bonus structure.
Opportunities for responsibility, ownership, and career growth as the business expands
Group Health Insurance Plan
Follow us on LinkedIn and stay updated on our latest news
We respect your personal data. All personal information in your application and CV will remain strictly confidential.

At Metlen Energy & Metals we are proud to have Diversity and Inclusion at the centre of everything we do. We are committed to Equal Employment Opportunity regardless of race, colour, national origin, ethnicity, gender, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or religion.

4452702000,https://ch.linkedin.com/jobs/view/risk-compliance-analytics-engineer-at-pictet-group-4452702000?position=32&pageNum=0&refId=l39hWZCuCyXnWenotZoztQ%3D%3D&trackingId=o1r%2B3e8qU6rHiiJ6xxermA%3D%3D,Risk & Compliance Analytics Engineer,Pictet Group,"Geneva, Geneva, Switzerland","Your team

Corporate Functions includes the Group’s non-banking activities and employs more than 900 people. These functions are carried out by specialists with expertise across all business units and include the Communications, Compliance, Corporate Office, Finance, Human Resources, Information Security, Internal Audit, Legal, Risk, Strategy & Projects, and Tax departments.

You will join the Risk & Compliance Data Office, which aims to be the trusted and innovative data partner for the Group’s Risk & Compliance community. The unit empowers informed decision making and proactive risk management through cutting edge technology, scalable platforms and high-quality data. Its mission is to deliver reliable, well-governed and forward-looking data solutions that meet evolving regulatory requirements, foster data driven insights and enable confident, strategic decision making.

This position will initially focus more strongly on data engineering, supporting the evolution of Risk & Compliance data platforms and the migration of data and analytics capabilities to Snowflake. As with all Analytics Engineers, the role is expected to evolve over time in response to business needs and team priorities.
Your role

Working with risk managers, compliance officers and executive leadership to translate strategic goals and regulatory requirements into robust, high-quality data products, including analytics, dashboards and reporting solutions.

Acting as a trusted data advisor to stakeholders, providing guidance and support to ensure effective use of analytics and reporting, while translating ambiguous business requirements into clear, actionable technical specifications.
Taking end-to-end ownership of business themes by proactively driving initiatives that align data solutions with business needs and deliver measurable value, from data source to executive insight.
Developing the architecture and managing the end-to-end value chain for risk and compliance data verticals, ensuring that the resulting analytics and reports can be used across the Group.
Designing and rolling out precise, executive-ready metrics and interactive dashboards that stand up to regulatory scrutiny and support the Group’s strategic risk posture.

Driving the modernisation and streamlining of legacy business logic by migrating and automating solutions into modern data architectures and cloud platforms, as well as implementing innovative approaches, such as AI, intelligent agents and automation, to enhance analytics capabilities.
Ensuring rigorous data quality and controls in line with the Group's data governance framework in order to maintain the integrity of mission-critical risk and compliance data.
Managing high-volume, time-sensitive ad hoc requests and complex regulatory reports autonomously and resiliently.
Proactively engaging with stakeholders to anticipate their needs, identifying opportunities for data-driven improvements and championing best practices in analytics and reporting.
Contributing to cross-functional initiatives to align the Risk & Compliance community and the Group on data governance, data strategy, data literacy and best practices.
Your profile
A master’s degree in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Finance, Engineering or a related field. Advanced certifications (e.g. FRM or CFA) would be a plus.
At least five years’ experience in a high impact data role, such as Data Engineering, Data Analytics or AI/ML, including hands-on expertise.
Expert-level proficiency in SQL and Python, including the design, maintenance and orchestration of modern ETL/ELT workflows.
Experience with Snowflake and modern cloud-based data platforms would be a strong asset.
Experience with business intelligence and reporting platforms such as Tableau, Power BI or equivalent.
Knowledge of risk management, compliance, banking operations and/or regulatory reporting would be an advantage.
Entrepreneurial and “can‑do” attitude, with the ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a fast‑paced matrix environment.
Strong communication, problem solving, organisational, interpersonal and project management skills.
Excellent command of French and English, both written and spoken.
Must be resident in Switzerland, or willing to relocate.
Note
We will not accept any CVs via agencies.
Ref.: R&CAE/MH/JC
Diversity & Inclusion
Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.

GenTwo is a global financial engineering company enabling the creation, issuance, and lifecycle management of innovative investment products. With our state-of-the-art platform and securitization infrastructure, we empower financial institutions, asset managers, and professional investors to bring new investment ideas to market faster, more efficiently, and without traditional constraints.
We are a Series-B-stage company with global ambitions, serving clients in more than 25 countries. We value clarity, ownership, and people who thrive in complexity.
Our core values
Stronger Together
Create Clarity
I Own It
Figure It Out
Location: Zurich, Switzerland
Department: CRM & Data Insights
Employment Type: Full-time
Who you are:

As a Customer Data Specialist, you don’t just pull the numbers - you make them worth trusting. You keep CRM data clean, processes well-governed, and every number traceable to its source. You’re comfortable connecting the dots across CRM, GTM systems, and campaign data, and just as confident explaining what the numbers mean to leadership.
If you want to own the data layer that powers how a fast-growing fintech goes to market, let’s talk!
Your tasks & responsibilities:
You turn data into decisions: You analyse campaign performance, conversion rates, pipeline quality, and translate what you find into recommendations people act on.
You build the reporting layer: Dashboards that are accurate, self-refreshing, and built on KPI definitions everyone has agreed to.
You make the business self-sufficient: You resolve advanced reporting requests fast, and reduce the next one through governed self-service, documentation, and a bit of training.

You own CRM: You make sure our workflows meet business needs, and that permissions, integrations, and configurations stay aligned with how the business sells. You're also the first call when something breaks.

You guard data quality: You keep customer acquisition data complete, accurate, and consistent across HubSpot and the tools around it. When something drifts out of line, you spot it early, get to the bottom of it, and fix it with the stakeholders involved, at the source wherever that's possible.

You use AI where it makes sense: You know where AI can simplify repetitive work and improve efficiency, and where it adds unnecessary complexity. You apply it thoughtfully to solve real business problems.
What you bring:
3–5 years in customer analytics, revenue/marketing operations, or BI, ideally in fintech, SaaS, or a similarly fast-moving environment.
Hands-on HubSpot/Salesforce experience, including admin and workflow work.

Strong reporting and analytics skills, including hands-on Power BI experience and working with data across multiple sources, systems, and channels. Familiarity with data warehouse or lakehouse concepts is a plus.
You’re confident working with stakeholders across the business, translating their needs into data solutions and explaining findings in a clear, actionable way.
You already use AI tools in your daily work and are curious about where they go next.
Fluent in English

Location: Zurich
Work Pattern Percentage: 80-100%

Möchtest du im Bereich Consulting für Künstliche Intelligenz und Dat en Kundinnen und Kunden dabei unterstützen, strategische Entscheidungen zu treffen? Unser Team begleitet die Umsetzung umfangreicher Datenprogramme. Werde Teil unseres Teams und gestalte mit uns die Zukunft.

Wir unterstützen unsere Kunden beim Aufbau modernster Datenlandschaften, um ihre Analysefähigkeit auf das nächste Level zu bringen. Du analysierst und verstehst kundenspezifische Lösungen von der Datenintegration, Datentransformation bis hin zu Analytics - mit dem Ziel das Datenmanagement unter Einsatz von State- of - the -Art Technologien nachhaltig zu verbessern.
Für diese Position bieten wir derzeit Starttermine ab September 202 6 an.
Dein Impact

Entwurf und Implementierung moderner Datenlösungen im Bereich Datenmanagement (z. B. Datenqualität, Stamm- und Referenzdaten, Datenkataloge und Datenplattformen), um qualitativ hochwertige und verwertbare Daten bereitzustellen.
Entwicklung von Datenstrategien, die unseren Kunden dabei helfen, ihre Geschäftsziele in den Bereichen Compliance, Kostensenkung und Umsatzsteigerung zu erreichen.

Konzeption komplexer Daten- und Analytik-Transformationen durch die Bereitstellung architektonischer, technischer und organisatorischer Grundlagen sowie Beratung der Kunden bei der Durchführung dieser Transformationen, die erhebliche Auswirkungen auf die Organisation haben .
Aufbau und Pflege enger Kundenbeziehungen im Rahmen von Projektarbeit oder Business Development sowie Erweiterung des internen und externen Netzwerks.
Vorbildfunktion durch hohe Arbeitsmoral, ausgeprägte Führungsqualitäten und fachliche Kompetenz.
Weiterentwicklung deiner Kompetenzen in verschiedenen Branchen und Fachgebieten sowie Weitergabe deines Wissens an Kolleginnen und Kollegen.
Wen wir suchen
Antrieb und Motivation
Leidenschaftliche Persönlichkeiten, die eine Karriere in der Beratung mit Schwerpunkt Data Engineering aufbauen möchten .
Ausgeprägte Lernbereitschaft, Offenheit für neue Themen und die Fähigkeit, mehrere Aufgaben selbstständig in einem dynamischen Umfeld zu steuern .
Beratungs- und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten
Starke Schreib- und Microsoft PowerPoint-Fähigkeiten: Fähigkeit, aussagekräftige Präsentationen zu gestalten .
Starke konzeptionelle Fähigkeiten: Fähigkeit, unterschiedliche Anforderungen zu einem stimmigen Lösungsdesign zusammenzuführen und komplexe Probleme zu vereinfachen .
Business-IT-Übersetzer: Fähigkeit, als Brücke zwischen Geschäftsanforderungen und technischen Lösungen zu fungieren .
Liebe zum Detail und Fähigkeit, technische Spezifikationen klar in schriftlicher und mündlicher Form zu kommunizieren .
Technische Expertise
Praktische Erfahrung mit Datenmanagement, Datenplattformen oder Data Engineering-Lösungen ist dringend empfohlen .
Fundierte Kenntnisse in SQL und Python sind erforderlich .
Erfahrung mit Cloud-Plattformen wie AWS, Azure oder GCP, einschließlich der Arbeit mit Data Warehouses , ETL-Tools und modernen Data Stack-Technologien ist erforderlich .
Kenntnisse von Datenplattform-Tools (z.B. Snowflake, Databricks , Apache Spark, Airflow ) und Datenvisualisierungstools (z.B. PowerBI , Tableau) sind erforderlich .
Praktische Erfahrung mit ETL/ELT-Pipelines und Data Orchestration (z.B. Apache Airflow , Prefect , dbt ) ist erforderlich .
Verständnis von Data Warehouse- und Data Lake-Architekturen sowie deren Unterschiede und Anwendungsfälle .
Kenntnisse von Datenmodellierung und Optimierungstechniken .
Starker Ingenieur- oder Mathematik-Hintergrund ist vorteilhaft .
Sprachkompetenz
Fließend in Englisch , Deutsch und/oder Französisch ist sehr erwünscht, um die Kommunikation mit verschiedenen Teams und Stakeholdern zu erleichtern .
Branchenerfahrun g
Erste relevante Erfahrung in Beratung, Technologieunternehmen oder branchenspezifischen Rollen, insbesondere in datengestützten Bereichen .
Frühere Erfahrung im Banking-, Versicherungs-, Life Science- oder Healthcare -Sektor ist vorteilhaft .
Dein Team

Werde Teil eines diversen und multinationalen Teams von 50+ hochmotivierten Kolleginnen und Kollegen in unseren Büros in Zürich, Genf oder Basel. Wir sind spezialisiert auf KI und Daten - wie sie strukturiert, beschafft, transformiert, gespeichert und genutzt werden können. Werde Teil unseres dynamischen und unterhaltsamen Teams und arbeite mit hochtalentierten Kolleginnen und Kollegen an abwechslungsreichen und spannenden Projekten, mit Zugang zu hervorragenden und fortlaufend verfügbaren Lernmöglichkeiten.

Deloitte AI & Data ist das führende Data & Analytics Consulting Team in der Schweiz. Du wirst die Möglichkeit haben, mit erstklassigen Kolleginnen und Kollegen zu arbeiten und Zugang zu einer Vielzahl von Kund en , Anbietern und Technologien zu haben. Unser Geschäftsbereich wächst schnell und es gibt viele Möglichkeiten, deine Karriere selbst zu definieren.

Wir helfen dir, dich persönlich und beruflich weiterzuentwickeln: durch unsere Schulungen, Mentoring-Programme und On- the -Job-Lernen, aber auch durch die Zusammenarbeit mit Kunden und Partnern aus verschiedenen Branchen.
Arbeiten bei Deloitte

Bei Deloitte zeigen deine Ideen Wirkung und lösen bedeutende Veränderungen für unsere Kunden, Menschen und die Gesellschaft aus. Dein Fachwissen, deine Erfahrung und deine Perspektive helfen uns, neue Wege für die komplexesten Herausforderungen zu finden, damit wir die Zukunft all derer verbessern können, auf die unsere Arbeit einen Einfluss hat. Bei Deloitte kannst du eine Karriere aufbauen, die dich inspiriert und jeden Tag aufs Neue motiviert. Bei Deloitte "" you can choose your impact "".

In der Schweiz erbringen wir branchenspezifische Dienstleistungen in den Bereichen Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal, Strategy, Risk & Transactions Advisory, and Technology & Transformation . Mit mehr als 3.000 Mitarbeitern an sechs Standorten betreuen wir Unternehmen und Organisationen jeder Grösse in allen Branchen. Wir bieten dir eine sinnvolle und herausfordernde Arbeit, einen Ort, an dem du selbst sein kannst und an dem du nie aufhören wirst, dich weiterzuentwickeln. Du profitierst von flexiblen Arbeitsbedingungen sowie Wellbeing- und Elternprogrammen.

Schliess dich uns an und werde Teil eines globalen Netzwerks von Gleichgesinnten, die sich dafür einsetzen, etwas zu bewegen, sei es durch die Bekämpfung des Klimawandels oder die Verbesserung von 100 Millionen Zukunftsperspektiven bis 2030. About The Team

eBay is the #1 Collectibles marketplace in the world, selling to millions of customers globally. Our mission is to be the most loved destination for collectors of trading cards, memorabilia, toys, comics, coins, and more. To accomplish this, we put our collectors first and innovate tirelessly to optimize experiences across our platform.

eBay Collectibles is looking for an EU Inventory Insights Manager to drive deep understanding of where to play and how to win within the broad and diverse collectibles market. This analytics pro will leverage data to advise where we focus incentives, seller acquisition efforts, buyer programming, retention/loyalty, and where we should execute our strategy across the entire EU collectibles portfolio. This role’s remit encompasses critical analytics work that will inform strategy and operational day-to-day decision making within one of eBay's most passionate and rapidly expanding categories. The ideal candidate will possess a complete analytical toolkit including how to synthesize data into actionable strategic and operational insights.

eBay would not be what it is today without our amazing employees -– from Inventory Insights leaders to Customer Support and everyone in between. We take great pride in hiring and developing top talent who can add to our culture and believe in our mission. eBay is an exciting opportunity to harness a growth mindset and engage with a passionate community of enthusiasts, fostering a vibrant and dynamic marketplace.
About The Role

This is a critical analytics role for the European Collectibles team, whose charter is to grow the category by continuing to make eBay a trusted and top-of-mind destination for Collectors. We are looking for someone to enable strategy execution. You will support initiatives ranging from analyzing data to understanding what is eBay’s next focus area to optimizing existing operations. You will also partner with the category managers within EU Collectibles, the wider global Collectibles teams, the Product and Technology teams, and other business teams on different initiatives. This role requires someone who has the technical skills to extract and analyze data as well as develop visualizations to communicate insights in an easily digestible way.
Responsibilities
Extract data and derive data-driven insights to inform decision making
Support development of A/B tests related to buyer and seller trust, behavior, and inventory velocity
Build reporting dashboards and scorecards
Support data needs for operating and strategic discussions with the Collectibles leadership team
Support the development of executive-ready presentations on strategy and operational updates
Work cross-functionally with peer analytics partners to develop comprehensive tools and business recommendations
Qualifications
Experience:
5 -7 years in analytics
Technical Requirements
Advanced SQL coding (+ demonstrated expertise working with and pulling data from Data Warehouse)
Advanced MS Excel
Demonstrated expertise developing and updating scorecards / dashboards in Tableau and MS Excel
Proficient in MS Powerpoint and Google Presentations
Other Requirements/differentiators
Able to thoughtfully apply detailed logic and methods to solve problems and enable decision making
Able to build constructive and effective relationships with a broad and diverse group of business partners
Track record of presenting ideas and directions to influence others into taking desired actions
Able to evaluate financial and business indicators and translate data into concrete information to get results
Strong communications, including the ability to tell a compelling story backed by data
Desire to engage with customers directly and passionate about helping eBay win!

In this high-impact role, you will transform workforce data into actionable insights that help leaders make smarter talent and organizational decisions.

Working closely with HR leaders, HR Directors, HR Business Partners, and business stakeholders, you will combine advanced analytics, data storytelling, and consultative problem-solving to drive workforce strategy and business outcomes.
What You'll Do
Deliver data-driven workforce insights across key people metrics, translating complex analyses into clear recommendations that inform strategic decision-making
Design and maintain scalable data pipelines, dashboards, and reporting solutions using SQL, Power BI, and cloud-based platforms

Partner with senior HR leadership (Divisional Vice Presidents, Senior HR Directors) to solve workforce challenges through data-driven decision-making
Leverage automation and AI-enabled tools (e.g., Copilot, Generative AI and automated analytics platforms) to improve efficiency and speed to insight
Incorporate external benchmarks and labor market insights to contextualize workforce analytics findings
Connect analytical outputs to strategic workforce priorities such as workforce planning, Scenario modelling, and HR investment decisions
Qualifications
5+ years of experience in People Analytics, Workforce Analytics, Data Analytics, or a related HR Domain field
Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Data Science, Economics, Psychology, or related field
column2: master’s degree preferred

Proficiency in Python and/or R for analytics and statistical modeling
Experience with Power BI, Tableau, or similar data visualization tools
Experience applying statistical methods such as regression, predictive modeling, or classification techniques in workforce contexts

Demonstrated experience interfacing with and influencing senior HR leadership (Senior Directors, Divisional Vice Presidents), with a high degree of professionalism, business acumen, and executive communication capability.
Fluent English
Why Join Abbott?
Career development with an international company where you can grow your career
Build a unique combination of technical, consulting, and strategic leadership capabilities
A challenging position where you can influence enterprise workforce and talent decisions on a global scale

Translate business requirements into clear specifications and discuss and validate them jointly with business and IT

Coordinate and perform testing of new and enhanced analytics solutions and manage the business sign-off and approval process
Proactively identify opportunities to enhance existing analytics solutions and processes and drive their implementation independently
Act as a trusted point of contact for business and IT on all matters related to analytics solutions, fostering strong cross-team collaboration
Stay up to date on developments in reporting and analytics technologies to continuously improve our solution landscape
Define and drive implementation of analytics related AI use cases jointly with AI teams.

Minimum 3 years of first hands-on experience or consulting experience in business analysis, reporting or analytics
Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Business Administration, Information Systems, Computer Science, Economics or a related field
Solid technical understanding of analytics and reporting solutions and the underlying data
column2: experience with Power BI and/or Pigment is a strong plus

Location: Lausanne, Switzerland
Work model: Hybrid / Full time 100%
Contract type / duration: Permanent
Shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation.

As a Lab Data Technology Specialist at Nestlé Research within our Computational Sciences department, you will be responsible for reinforcing our laboratory data foundations to help unlock the full value of the data generated by our scientific instruments and laboratory systems. Sitting at the intersection of science, laboratory data, and modern data engineering, you will leverage latest data technologies and AI for coding tools to transform raw, heterogeneous scientific data into trusted, well-documented, and reusable data assets that accelerate impactful scientific research.
How you’ll make an impact as a Lab Data Technology Specialist

Partner with laboratory stakeholders. data domain owners, lab business analysts together with data architects and engineers to translate functional requirements into scalable, and well-documented technical solutions, ensuring alignment between scientific workflows and technological capabilities

Enable new and existing laboratory instruments end to end, from understanding the scientific workflow and data outputs to defining and establishing connectivity and data flow (LIMS, robotics, automation platforms, downstream systems), in collaboration with IT network, security specialists

Collaborate with internal and external professionals to propose and implement customizations to lab digital platforms used (LIMS, instrument integration, technology specific data processing, metadata capture) in view of efficiency, quality, traceability, and governance by design
Identify opportunities to increase value of lab data gathered across different sources by leveraging data technologies (data integrations, data warehousing, automated data quality checks, etc)

Support testing, deployment, change management, and continuous improvement of compliant, scalable lab solutions, including AI-enabled opportunities to strengthen data flows and unlock value from lab data
What Will Make You Successful

Bachelor's or Master's degree in a scientific or computational discipline (e.g., Chemistry, life sciences, Bioinformatics, Cheminformatics, Data Engineering, Computer Science), or equivalent experience.
Solid experience in applying data engineering to scientific, laboratory data
Required technical skills
LIMS customization, data models, and integration.
Integrating lab instruments, applications, robots, and IoT with reference databases and data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake).
Solid grasp of the lab solutions ecosystem: ELN, CDS, LES, multi-omics pipelines, IoT-connected equipment, barcode systems, etc.
Programming (e.g., Python, R, Java, Groovy).
Data engineering and modeling — ETL/ELT (Airflow, dbt), APIs, orchestration, SQL/NoSQL — with engineering rigor (Git, CI/CD, testing, data quality, observability, reproducibility).
Nice-to-have technical skills
Semantic modeling, ontologies, and knowledge graphs (e.g., RDF/SPARQL, biomedical/chemical vocabularies).
FAIR data implementation, metadata management, and lineage tooling
Enabling AI/ML and analytics use cases on scientific data
Domain exposure in chemistry, biology, food, or omics
Reporting tools (e.g., DASH, Streamlit, Power BI) is an advantage
Leveraging Agentic AI to automate data engineering activities
Required non-technical skills
Strong problem-solving and hands-on mindset
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
Experience collaborating with external vendors and data professionals and driving delivery through others
Ability to work in cross-functional and international teams
Strong organizational and prioritization skills
Fluent spoken and written English
At Nestlé Research, we place people at the core of everything we do.
Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:
Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office based roles)
Paid holidays beyond legal requirements
Learning and development opportunities to grow your career
Performance based bonus
Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program
Strong employer contribution to your pension plan
Generous parental leave and comprehensive family support solutions
Attractive employee discounts across various products and services
What To Expect From Our Hiring Process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes a video interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.
Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Tu es à l'aise avec les environnements de développement modernes et les pratiques de versioning et d'intégration continue, notamment Git et les processus CI/CD.
Tu disposes de notions ou d'une expérience sur la plateforme Microsoft Fabric et tu t’intéresses aux évolutions technologiques liées aux architectures Data modernes.

Possibilité de télétravail

Gute SQL-Kenntnisse und Erfahrung mit Data-Warehouse-Strukturen und relationalen Datenbanken
Analytisches Denkvermögen, hohe Zahlenaffinität und gutes unternehmerisches Verständnis
Interesse an KI und Automatisierung im Controlling- und Analytics-Umfeld

Möchtest du anspruchsvolle Daten analysieren, statistische Methoden praktisch einsetzen und daraus verständliche Datenprodukte entwickeln, die im Alltag einen konkreten Nutzen schaffen?

Für unser Team Bevölkerung, Wirtschaft und Raum (BWR) suchen wir eine technisch versierte und neugierige Persönlichkeit, die fachliche Fragestellungen gemeinsam mit unterschiedlichen Fachpersonen bearbeitet und daraus verlässliche, nachvollziehbare Data-Science-Lösungen entwickelt. Damit schaffen wir vergleichbare statistische Grundlagen für Monitoring und Planung.
Deine Aufgaben
Du verantwortest mindestens einen Themenbereich fachlich und stellst die Vertretung für mehrere weitere sicher.
Du beantwortest Anfragen und deckst Informationsbedürfnisse von Verwaltung, Bevölkerung, Parlament, Medien und weiteren Interessengruppen.
Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit den beteiligten Fachpersonen fundierte Analysen und Datenprodukte und begleitest deren technische Umsetzung bis zur produktiven Nutzung.

Du entwickelst reproduzierbare Datenpipelines sowie statistische Modelle und Verfahren und überführst geeignete Ansätze gemeinsam mit dem Team in verlässlich nutzbare Lösungen, um Datenanalysen transparent und nachvollziehbar zu gestalten.

Du entwickelst strukturierten und getesteten Code, vorwiegend in R, und arbeitest an wiederverwendbaren Paketen und Komponenten mit. Git, Code Reviews und automatisierte Tests gehören dabei zu deiner täglichen Entwicklungsarbeit.

Du erschliesst und beurteilst Datenquellen, achtest auf Datenqualität und Nachvollziehbarkeit und vermittelst Methoden, Annahmen und Ergebnisse auch gegenüber nichttechnischen Anspruchsgruppen verständlich.

Du verfügst über einen Masterabschluss in Data Science, Informatik, Statistik, Mathematik, Volkswirtschaftslehre, Computational Science oder einem vergleichbaren quantitativen Fachgebiet.

Du hast praktische Erfahrung in Data Science, Data Engineering oder Scientific Software Engineering und bereits Datenanalysen, Datenpipelines, Modelle oder vergleichbare Datenlösungen selbständig umgesetzt.
Du verfügst über fundierte Kenntnisse in Statistik, Datenmodellierung und Datenqualität.
Du beherrschst R und/oder Python sehr gut und kannst damit strukturierten, getesteten und wartbaren Code entwickeln.
Du kennst grundlegende Praktiken professioneller Softwareentwicklung. Git-basierte Zusammenarbeit, Code Reviews und automatisierte Tests sind dir vertraut.
Du hast Erfahrung in der Koordination von Projekten oder in der Zusammenarbeit mit unterschiedlichen Fachdisziplinen und Anspruchsgruppen.

Du arbeitest selbständig, sorgfältig und lösungsorientiert. Komplexe fachliche und technische Sachverhalte kannst du strukturieren, unterschiedliche Perspektiven aufnehmen und deine Ergebnisse und Entscheidungen verständlich vermitteln.
Du kommunizierst stilsicher auf Deutsch. Deine Englischkenntnisse ermöglichen dir den sicheren Umgang mit technischer Dokumentation und internationaler Fachliteratur.
Von Vorteil
Kenntnisse in SQL und relationaler Datenmodellierung.
Kenntnisse in SAS oder Erfahrung im Umgang mit bestehenden SAS-Prozessen.
Erste Erfahrung mit produktiv betriebenen Datenpipelines, Paketentwicklung, CI/CD oder vergleichbaren Data-Science-Engineering-Praktiken.
Erfahrung mit Daten und Prozessen der öffentlichen Statistik oder vergleichbaren regulierten Datenumgebungen.
Dein Arbeitgeber

LUSTAT Statistik Luzern ist das Kompetenz- und Dienstleistungszentrum der öffentlichen Statistik im Kanton Luzern. Die Statistikstelle erhebt und analysiert Daten aus dem Kanton Luzern und seinen Gemeinden und stellt diese Informationen der Öffentlichkeit benutzergerecht zur Verfügung. Zudem bietet sie individuelle, kostenpflichtige Leistungen an. Dazu gehören fachliche und methodische Beratungen, Sonderauswertungen, Gesamtdarstellungen, Szenarien und Modellrechnungen.
Worauf du dich freuen kannst

Du arbeitest an vielfältigen statistischen Fragestellungen mit direktem Nutzen für Bevölkerung, Verwaltung, Politik, Wirtschaft, Wissenschaft und Medien und bist eng mit Fachpersonen aus unterschiedlichen Disziplinen im Austausch. Du arbeitest in einem interdisziplinären Umfeld mit hoher Daten- und Methodenkompetenz.

Wir entwickeln unsere Datenverarbeitung kontinuierlich weiter und setzen dabei verstärkt auf R, reproduzierbare Workflows und moderne Entwicklungspraktiken. Du kannst diese Entwicklung aktiv mitgestalten.
Wir bauen unsere Entwicklungspraktiken gezielt weiter aus und setzen dabei zunehmend auf Git, Code Reviews, automatisierte Tests, reproduzierbare Prozesse und CI/CD.

Open-Source-Lösungen und On-Premises-Betrieb spielen in unserem technischen Umfeld eine wichtige Rolle. Dabei lernst du auch, wie technische Möglichkeiten mit den Anforderungen an Datenschutz und Informationssicherheit in Einklang gebracht werden.

Wir unterstützen dich dabei, deine Kenntnisse in Statistik, Softwareentwicklung und Data Science weiterzuentwickeln. Dazu gehören interne und externe Weiterbildungen ebenso wie der fachliche Austausch und die praktische Arbeit an produktiven Datenlösungen.

Flexible Jahresarbeitszeit, bis zu drei Tage Homeoffice pro Woche, ein moderner Arbeitsplatz im neuen Gebäude der kantonalen Verwaltung des Kantons Luzern direkt neben dem Bahnhof Emmenbrücke ergänzen unser Angebot.
Das «a» im Stellentitel steht für «alle». Der Kanton Luzern steht für Diversität und Vielfalt.

profissional proativo, orientado a resultados e com forte senso de ownership, capaz de atuar de forma estratégica e executiva na evolução do CRM orientado a dados.

Experiência prévia como Analista de Dados / BI / CRM.
Atuação em times cross-funcionais, colaborando com múltiplas áreas.

profissional proativo, orientado a resultados e com forte senso de ownership, capaz de atuar de forma estratégica e executiva na evolução do CRM orientado a dados.

Qualifications

O que buscamos em você!

  • Experiência com ferramentas de BI (ex: Power BI, Tableau, Looker ou similares)
  • Familiaridade com ambientes de dados (Data Warehouse, Data Lake, pipelines)
  • Entendimento de métricas de CRM, marketing, vendas e lifecycle
  • Boa capacidade de documentação e comunicação de análises

🧠 Nosso Mindset
Tudo o que fazemos é guiado por três mindsets que sustentam nossa cultura e orientam nossas decisões:
Human Centered Mindset | Growth Mindset

Liderança Formadora
